Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: launching a $300 annual Mental Health & Wellbeing stipend and a clarified Flexible Leave procedure for short-term needs. Effective 2026-07-01. Policy + claim form: https://redwood.atlassian.org/people-ops/benefits/mh-stipend-2026

Benefits-Bot: Stipend eligible items: therapy sessions, wellness apps, approved classes, and ergonomic home-office equipment up to $300/year. Receipts required for claims over $50.

Diego Ramos: Nice! Is previous unused PTO required before taking flexible leave?

Maya (People Ops): No. Flexible Leave is separate and intended for short interruptions (up to 5 consecutive business days) for health, caregiving, or urgent personal needs. Managers should approve and log the reason category; PTO remains for planned time off.

Priya Singh: Can the stipend be split across multiple vendors? e.g., app subscription + one therapy session?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, split is fine. Submit receipts totaling up to $300. For recurring subscriptions, we ask you to attach a screenshot of the plan and payment date.

Diego Ramos: Timeline for reimbursements?

Benefits-Bot: Typical processing 5-10 business days after submission. If urgent, include "EXPEDITE-MH" in the subject and People Ops will prioritize.

Priya Singh: Will managers see stipend claims?

Maya (People Ops): Managers see that a stipend was used (for headcount reporting) but not the itemized private details. We redact sensitive treatment notes.

Maya (People Ops): I'll run a 20-min walkthrough next Tue 10:00 PT in #people-ops-office-hours and update the FAQ with examples. Ping me or people-ops@redwood.com with questions. :heart:
